description: Landesentwicklungsplan 2013-Verkehr is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Freistaat Sachsen. Der Datensatz beinhaltet Daten der Karte "Verkehrsinfrastruktur" des Landesentwicklungsplanes 2013. Ausgewiesen werden Neubautrassen und Korridore im Straßen- und Eisenbahnnetz sowie symbolhaft weitere Neubaumaßnahmen im Straßennetz. Bestandsdaten der Verkehrsinfrastruktur sind nicht Bestandteil des Datensatzes. Coverage: Freistaat Sachsen. The portal files it under the publisher Freistaat Sachsen. Its tags are ausbau, korridor, landesentwicklung, landesentwicklungsplan, landesverkehrsplan. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
